# EMUSKI

> ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certified precision contract manufacturing and cost engineering solutions provider based in Electronic City, Bangalore, India. Serving automotive, aerospace, EV, and medical device OEMs globally since 2008.

## Core Services & Solutions
- [Contract Manufacturing Services](https://www.emuski.com/manufacturing-services): Turnkey multi-axis CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, injection molding, rapid prototyping, and electronics manufacturing services (EMS).
- [Cost Engineering & VAVE](https://www.emuski.com/cost-engineering): Should-cost analysis, teardown-based cost benchmarking, and design-for-manufacturing (DFM) unlocking 15–25% cost reduction.
- [Mithran AI Platform](https://www.emuski.com/solutions/ai): AI-assisted product cost estimation, automated DFM risk intelligence, and strategic sourcing.
- [Bangalore Manufacturing Hub](https://www.emuski.com/manufacturing-in-bangalore): Precision engineering and component sourcing for automotive, aerospace, EV, and medical device OEMs.

## Technical Specifications
- Tolerances: Down to ±0.005 mm
- Primary Materials: Aluminum (6061, 7075), Stainless Steel (304, 316), Titanium, Inconel, Brass, POM/Delrin
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018

## About
- Founded: 2008, Electronic City Phase 2, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Industries served: Automotive, Aerospace, EV, Medical Devices, Electronics, Defense
- Average cost reduction achieved: 15–25% via should-cost/DFM analysis; 20–30% via VAVE methodology
- Client base: Fortune 500 companies and global OEMs, 75+ international clients served
- Address: 126, RNS Plaza, KIADB Industrial Area, Electronic City Phase 2, Bangalore, Karnataka 560100, India
